references.text: The Lord had previously promised to give the land into Israel's hands, a promise now made concrete with Jericho
The spies confirm to Joshua that the Lord has given the whole land into their hands, as promised in Josh 6:2
The same promise is given concerning Ai – the Lord gives the city and its king into Joshua's hand
The Lord gives the same assurance of victory over the five Amorite kings
Moses receives a similar promise that God will give Sihon into Israel's hands
Promise that the Lord will give the kings into Israel's hands
Hebrews refers to the fall of Jericho by faith, where the walls fell after the people had marched around the city for seven days
The same language is used where the Lord says he has given the enemy into Gideon's hand
